name: ai.lightray/lightray
title: LightRay
description: Send a company name and city, get a report on what registers, filings, courts and the press show.

tools.name: check_company
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about a company or wants one checked. Give the company's name and, if known, its city or country. If a recent report on the company is stored, it comes back at once; otherwise a new report starts and the answer says when it will be ready. A new report uses one of the reader's reports; asking again for the same company does not. When several companies match the name, the answer lists them: ask the reader which one they mean, then call this again with that company's choice token. LightRay checks companies, not people.

name.description: The company's name, as it is registered if known: its legal name with its legal form, such as Limited or LLC.

place.description: The company's city or country, if known. It helps find the right company.

choice.description: The choice token of one company from the list this tool returned when several matched. Give it with the same name.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Use this to see how far a report has got and what has been found so far, or to read a ready report: its date, the main point, any questions to ask, what was found, the next steps, the companies worth a look next and its link. LightRay writes each report: the main point, questions, findings and next steps are LightRay's. Give the report_id that check_company or list_reports returned, or the report's link. Reading a report uses none of the reader's reports.

report_id.description: The report_id that check_company or list_reports returned, or the report's link.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Use this to see the reader's recent reports from here, newest first, each with whether it is ready and its link. It uses none of the reader's reports.

limit.description: How many reports to list, newest first: 1 to 20. 10 if not given.
